text:
alex: Heads-up: proposing FlashAttention v3 integration into the runtime this week. Goal: enable v3 fused kernel where it measurably improves throughput/latency, fall back to v2 or v3_paged for corner cases. Need final flag names, canary plan, KV-cache regression checks, and a short smoketest we can run in staging.

jamie: Quick perf summary from microbenchmarks (A100/H100, FP16):
```
A100 (FP16), batch shapes mixed:
  seq=64  batch=64: v2=12.0k tok/s, v3_fused=18.5k tok/s (+54%), v3_paged=11.8k (-2%)
  seq=256 batch=32: v2=8.2k, v3_fused=11.3k (+38%), v3_paged=7.9k (-4%)
  seq=1024 batch=8: v2=5.9k, v3_fused=6.2k (+5%)
H100 shows similar gains for short seq but v3_paged regresses at seq~512 (unknown root cause).
CPU overhead for kernel selection ~<0.5ms per request.
```
Will attach raw perf logs to the ticket.

leah: Note on KV cache / paged interaction: we observed a correctness/regression case when prefix_cache=true + paged attention + batch split (multiple requests sharing device KV pages). Repro steps:
```
1) prefix_cache=true, kv_page_size=64MB, enable v3_paged
2) warm cache with long context, then send small prefix requests in batch of 8
3) observed token duplications in 0.3% of runs and occasional OOB reads logged by cuda.
```
Mitigation: gating paged by prefix_cache: if prefix_cache==true -> default to v3_fused or v2 until we have a safe eviction probe.

matt: Proposed feature flags and rollout phases (suggested names):
```
ff.attn.kernel = "auto" | "v2" | "v3_fused" | "v3_paged"
ff.attn.kernel_probe = true | false  // run lightweight microprobe before selecting v3
ff.attn.paged_threshold = 512  // seq length above which paged is allowed
```
Rollout plan (short):
  phase0: internal staging (5 nodes) + perf smoke + validation tests
  phase1: 5% prod traffic -> v3_fused for seq<=256, monitor for 48h
  phase2: 25% prod traffic + enable v3_paged for seq>512 behind strict KV checks
  phase3: ramp to 100% for eligible shapes and clean up flags after 2 weeks stable.
Make sure we have automatic fallback to v2 if kernel fails or errors spike >0.1%.

olivia: Metrics/alerts to add to the dashboard before any prod rollout: p50/p95 latency (generate and recv), tokens_per_second, kernel_fallback_rate, kv_hit_ratio, mem_spike_count, client_error_rate, model_output_drift (basic quality check). Suggested alert thresholds:
  kernel_fallback_rate > 0.5% for 5m -> pager
  p95 latency increase >20% baseline for 15m -> page on-call
  mem_spike_count > 3 in 10m -> auto-fallback to v2.
Also: add a small prompt-set quality smoke (5 prompts) that runs after each kernel switch and fails if outputs diverge by >10% BLEU-like heuristic.

perf-bot: Nightly bench (last run):
  a100_x8_staging_2026-03-17: v3_fused avg tok/s +45% vs v2 for seq<=128.
  h100_x4_staging_2026-03-17: v3_paged shows -8% at seq=512, investigating memory access pattern.
Attached perf artifacts: /artifacts/bench/3012345678/

sre-bot: Canary checklist (short):
  - alert runbook: /runbooks/attn_kernel_rollout.md (ensure on-call aware)
  - rollback flag ready: ff.attn.kernel=v2 immediate override
  - capacity cushion: reserve 20% spare to absorb slower kernels
  - telemetry retention: keep detailed traces for 72h when canary flag enabled
  - smoke test: 3x health-check + 5x prompt-quality checks post-deploy

alex: OK. Actions: @jamie can you open the rollout PR with the probe code and the perf artifacts attached? @matt please add the feature flags to the runtime config schema and draft the phased rollout in the infra runbook. @leah can you add the KV paged gating quick-fix to the canary config (prefix_cache -> disable paged)? @olivia please create the dashboard panels and alerts above. I'll schedule a 30m ops sync tomorrow to sign off on phase0. :thumbsup:

alex: If anyone has objections to the gating policy (disable paged when prefix_cache is true) speak up now, otherwise we will implement that for the initial canary.

jamie: No objections. I'll add a small probe that runs a KV-eviction microtest during warmup.

leah: I'll write the quick e2e that reproduces the duplication case and include it in the staging smoketest.

matt: I'll land the feature flag RFC and make the runtime change behind the ff.attn.kernel_probe guard.

olivia: Dashboard + alerts ticket created: D-1243. Will post links in the PR. :white_check_mark:

perf-bot: Bench attachments uploaded. Also logged a low-severity H100 paged-mode regression ticket: P-3301.

sre-bot: Scheduling note: don't start phase1 before Monday 09:00 PT to ensure full on-call coverage.

alex: Great — thanks everyone. We'll use the staging canary window tomorrow; keeping the initial ramp conservative.
